TeacherAccount.title: TeacherAccount
TeacherAccount.description: Activated subject teacher account authorized for Google Authentication in CBT SD Negeri 4 Lalembuu.

id.description: Unique identifier for the teacher account.

name.description: Full name and academic title of the teacher.

email.description: Google account email address activated for login.

subject.description: Assigned subject taught by the teacher.

isActive.description: Whether this teacher's Google account is currently activated for login.

isDemo.description: Whether this account is a demo account.

ownerId.description: UID of the creator or authenticated teacher.

/teacher_accounts/{teacherId}.description: Stores activated subject teacher accounts authorized to sign in via Google.
